results.title: Liste de Mariage
results.overview: A romantic Lebanese comedy that follows Lana as she unexpectedly reconnects with her ex at his wedding, only to find herself pretending to be in a relationship with a mysterious stranger. What begins as a harmless arrangement quickly turns into an emotional journey filled with humor, awkward encounters, and unexpected feelings.

results.title: NJPW Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall 2026
results.overview: Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 14, 2026, at Osaka-jō Hall in Osaka, Japan. The show was headlined by an IWGP Heavyweight Championship match between reigning champion Callum Newman and Yota Tsuji, who earned a title shot after pinning Newman in a tag team match at New Japan Road in Karatsu 2026 ~ Ignition to Dominion in May 2026.

results.title: Au nord des hommes
results.overview: A group of journalists ventures deep into the Québec wilderness to investigate a camp offering a mysterious retreat for men. Behind the seductive rhetoric and apparent camaraderie lies a full-fledged radical cell: they might have walked straight into a very dangerous engine.

results.title: Flowery Voices
results.overview: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

results.title: Home
results.overview: In the hope of creating a better life, 6-year-old Maja and her parents leave Yugoslavia for Denmark, leaving behind Maja’s two older brothers with the promise they will join once the family is settled. But the new country proves difficult and unfamiliar, and the family struggles to adapt to a new language, culture, and way of life. As the years pass, Maja grows up and becomes a successful artist in Denmark, yet beneath her achievements, she carries a divide of joy, sorrow, and gratitude—torn between the life she has built and the painful sacrifices her parents made for their future.

results.title: A Man and A Woman
results.overview: In the early spring of 2021, a man and a woman flew to Hong Kong at the same time, and while waiting to enter the mainland, they stayed in the same hotel, separated by a wall. During the short intersection of their lives, the two confided in each other about the pressure they were burdened with and found a spiritual harbor in Hong Kong, where tenacious vitality was blooming. And before the answer is revealed, the choice stops abruptly.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 18
results.overview: The eighteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 15, 2026 at Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, and included Hiroyoshi Tenzan's retirement match against Satoshi Kojima. The event also featured both tournament semifinals to determine the finalists.

results.title: Beneath the Light
results.overview: A man with a haunted past takes a job repairing an abandoned lighthouse that's only reachable by boat. His feelings of isolation and uneasiness grow as he starts to see the strange apparition of a young girl that he somehow recognizes.

results.title: Appofeniacs
results.overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

results.title: Poison
results.overview: Elzė returns to Lithuania from Switzerland for a vacation. She rents a cozy farmhouse in a remote village, hoping to find peace and inspiration for her painting. However, the idyllic peace is disturbed by Nojus. Their budding friendship soon sparks passion, and their love is intertwined with desire, longing, and fear. Elzė's past haunts her—she is being pursued by her ex-boyfriend. Will these two passion-driven people be able to overcome the shadows of the past and simply love each other?

results.title: Vygotsky
results.overview: Moscow, 1934. At the end of his life, anticipating his imminent departure, at the request of his loved ones, Lev Vygotsky agrees to several psychoanalytic sessions with the grand lady of world psychology, a student of Freud and Jung, Sabine Spielrein. Adhering to largely opposite views, two great scientists are trying to answer each other the main question of their time — is there a method to educate a "new person"?

results.title: Dress-Up
results.overview: A young couple, Charlie and Steph, both realize they're trans after having sex while wearing gender-swapped Halloween costumes. Charlie comes to terms with it faster than Steph, causing unexpected friction in their relationship.

results.title: Mary Magnum: Jiu-Jitsu Nun
results.overview: A former military sharpshooter turned nun breaks her vows when the woman she once loved falls into the hands of a ruthless crime boss. Armed with faith, a Magnum revolver, and jiu-jitsu, she wages a one-woman war for justice.

results.title: Peer Gynt
results.overview: Peer Gynt is a young Norwegian man who lives in fantasies and longs to become a king. Rejected by his village and scolded by his mother, he escapes into the forest – where his dreams begin to take shape when he meets the daughter of the mysterious Dovre King...

results.title: Ranger Rock
results.overview: When a string of murders suddenly brings the town of Stephenville into crisis a young detective looks to a retired superhero for help with the case, but when the mystery takes a dark turn, Arthur is forced to decide whether to stay in retirement, or to wear the cape once more.

results.title: The Tears of Bael
results.overview: Capitán Gato is a small-time drug dealer tormented by pain and his own inner demons.

results.title: Zaz aux Francofolies de la Rochelle
results.original_title: Zaz aux Francofolies de la Rochelle

results.title: Bardogento
results.overview: Juan constantly argues with his wife, takes sleeping pills, repeats to himself every day that life isn't going well, and confronts a friend in need over a past debt. And to top it all off, he ends up in a place where nothing is what it seems and where he will have to learn to reevaluate his life if he wants to return home.

results.title: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 7
results.overview: The seventh night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 13, 2026, at Osaka Kanaoka Park Gymnasium in Sakai, Osaka, Japan and featured two second-round matches.

results.title: You Are The Film
results.overview: Madoka writes plays. Kazuma composes music. One day, they decide to go to the cinema. But once there, they realise they can interact through the screen itself, sending fiction into joyful freefall in an absurd and inventive adventure.
